mutations.equivalent: The opportunistic sweep changes nothing a run can observe: what it does — drop cameras idle for a minute, trim a playlist cache past five hundred entries — needs either sixty seconds or five hundred cameras, and the background loop performs the same sweep on its own timer regardless. The policy itself is pinned by the_stale_sweep_drops_a_camera_that_stopped_pushing, which backdates the clock instead of waiting on it.

mutations.new:

            "'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x{:02x} in position {}: {reason}",
            bytes[start], start + 1
        )
